breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that beta must be computed using the film temperature in Kelvin (absolute units), not Celsius. The generated specification explicitly states 'β = 1/Tf with Tf in Kelvin, so β = 1/323.15 K^-1', which matches the ground truth requirement of 'beta ≈ 1/T_abs evaluated at the film temperature in Kelvin'.
